log.text: Floette used Light of Ruin → Grimmsnarl

decisions.rationale: Lead Dedenne and Mega Floette. Dedenne immediately threatens a guaranteed Pelipper KO, while Floette pressures Basculegion and can Protect around Aqua Jet. Mamoswine is the key backline answer to Garganacl and Hisuian Arcanine; Milotic adds bulk, Icy Wind control, and punishes opposing Intimidate with Competitive.
decisions.notebook: Opponent’s rain mode combines Pelipper’s Drizzle with strong Water pressure and Basculegion priority; Basculegion frequently Protects early. Grimmsnarl commonly uses Prankster Light Screen, while Garganacl repeatedly uses Wide Guard against spread attacks. Focused single-target pressure is effective. Mega Floette is an excellent offensive answer to the rain/screen core but must be preserved from Aqua Jet. Mamoswine is a strong backline answer to Garganacl and Hisuian Arcanine. Future plan: prioritize Dedenne’s Electric pressure, preserve Floette against priority, and avoid defaulting to spread moves into Garganacl.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Floettite Mega Floette. Lead Grimmsnarl+Sableye job: Prankster Taunt/Reflect turn 1 to shut Dedenne+Floette spam and set screens. Back Garganacl+Arcanine-Hisui complete physical wall + Intimidate pivot vs Fairy/Steel/Dark with speed control.
decisions.notebook: Opponent consistently leads Dedenne+Mega Floette with Magnet Thunderbolt; Rain weak vs Mamoswine; Arcanine-Hisui Intimidate pivot planned vs Fairy/Steel/Dark; Double Prankster screens + Garganacl wall core.

selection: Light of Ruin -> foe 1 (Grimmsnarl) + Mega Evolve
decisions.rationale: Dedenne applies immediate Electric pressure to Sableye, while Mega Floette’s super-effective Light of Ruin removes or heavily pressures Grimmsnarl before screens and Parting Shot can compound. This preserves both offensive pieces and avoids giving Sableye a free Recover turn.

decisions.rationale: Prankster Reflect lands first vs physical Nuzzle/Brave Bird later; Taunt stops Dedenne setup/Protect while screens establish Garganacl core.
decisions.notebook: Opponent leads Dedenne+Mega Floette with Magnet Thunderbolt; Rain weak vs Mamoswine; Arcanine-Hisui Intimidate pivot planned vs Fairy/Steel/Dark; Double Prankster screens + Garganacl wall core.

decisions.rationale: Arcanine-Hisui Intimidate planned vs Fairy lead; lowers both attackers while Sableye passes under Taunt and Reflect.

Thunderbolt is a guaranteed KO on Sableye before it can Recover or spread status. Floette Protects against Arcanine’s Rock Slide or ExtremeSpeed, preserving the Mega from priority and avoiding unnecessary recoil. This leaves a favorable two-on-one position.

decisions.rationale: ES finishes low-HP Floette before it moves; Prankster WoW burns faster Dedenne safely; Sableye too low to risk another hit.
decisions.notebook: Arcanine-Hisui Intimidate pivot planned vs Fairy/Steel/Dark; Double Prankster screens + Garganacl wall core; Rain weak vs Mamoswine.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Both foes are slower, so focused attacks act first and pressure each threat independently. Thunderbolt provides the best available pressure into Arcanine, while Energy Ball is super effective into Garganacl and bypasses Wide Guard. This avoids exposing Floette to another Rock Slide and punishes either Protect choice.
decisions.notebook: Opponent commonly uses Garganacl Wide Guard against spread attacks; focused single-target pressure is preferred. Rain mode combines Pelipper Drizzle with Basculegion Water pressure and Aqua Jet, while Basculegion often Protects early. Preserve Mega Floette from priority when possible; Mamoswine is a strong backline answer to Garganacl and Hisuian Arcanine.

selection: Wide Guard (your side, including ally Arcanine-Hisui)
decisions.rationale: ES finishes low-HP Floette before it moves; Wide Guard blocks Electroweb spread while Arcanine outspeeds most rolls; Reflect already up.

Dedenne’s Thunderbolt guarantees the KO on Arcanine despite Reflect, while Floette’s Protect denies its priority Extreme Speed. This preserves the Mega and removes the immediate threat; Garganacl cannot prevent the single-target Thunderbolt with Wide Guard. Floette can pressure Garganacl next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent repeatedly uses priority Extreme Speed to pressure Mega Floette and commonly answers spread attacks with Garganacl Wide Guard. Focused single-target attacks are preferred. Rain mode remains Pelipper plus Basculegion Water pressure; Basculegion often Protects early. Mamoswine is a strong backline answer to Garganacl and Hisuian Arcanine.

decisions.rationale: ES priority KOs 6% Floette safely; Salt Cure pressures Dedenne while burned and -1; Wide Guard unnecessary vs single-target focus.

Thunderbolt guarantees the KO on Arcanine, but Extreme Speed acts first and threatens Floette. Switching Floette to Mamoswine preserves the Mega while bringing in the known strong Garganacl answer. This avoids relying on Floette's reduced Protect success and removes Arcanine immediately.
decisions.notebook: Opponent repeatedly prioritizes Extreme Speed into Mega Floette and commonly uses Garganacl Wide Guard against spread attacks. Focused single-target attacks are preferred. Rain mode is Pelipper plus Basculegion Water pressure, with Basculegion often Protecting early. Mamoswine is a strong backline answer to Garganacl and Hisuian Arcanine.

decisions.rationale: ES priority finishes 6% Floette regardless of Protect odds; Salt Cure pressure on burned Dedenne secures chip/KO while Arcanine lives another turn; Wide Guard alternative only if spread confirmed.

Switch Dedenne to preserve the slot and bring in durable Milotic. Mamoswine moves before Garganacl and High Horsepower is a guaranteed KO from the shown HP, while Wide Guard cannot block it. Protect leaves Dedenne exposed to end-of-turn burn and Salt Cure damage; Electroweb risks Wide Guard and also fails to preserve Dedenne.
decisions.notebook: Opponent commonly uses Garganacl Wide Guard against spread attacks and prioritizes Extreme Speed into Mega Floette. Their rain option is Pelipper plus Basculegion, with Basculegion often Protecting early. Mamoswine remains a strong backline answer to Garganacl and Hisuian Arcanine.

decisions.rationale: Mamoswine faster SE threat; Salt Cure applies chip on it while Dedenne burns out at 3%. Recover or Wide Guard safer vs chip but delays wincon vs remaining foes.

Mamoswine moves before Garganacl and High Horsepower is a guaranteed KO from the shown HP, regardless of Recover or Wide Guard. Milotic should Recover to preserve its full-health endgame position rather than risk Muddy Water’s accuracy or waste Protect.
Garganacl outslowed and at 9% so will likely faint; Salt Cure on fresh Milotic applies lasting pressure before it dies while Mamoswine already afflicted.
decisions.notebook: Core is double Prankster screens into Garganacl wall; Arcanine-Hisui Intimidate pivot vs Fairy/Steel/Dark; rain weak vs Mamoswine; preserve Salt Cure value across games.

reflections.summary: Won because the four brought matched the opponent’s core: Dedenne removed Sableye and pressured Hisuian Arcanine, while Mamoswine and Milotic reliably closed into Garganacl. Mega Floette contributed useful pressure on Garganacl but was poorly positioned against repeated Extreme Speed, surviving only through Protect.
reflections.adjustment: Keep Mamoswine and Milotic as the primary Garganacl plan, but avoid exposing Mega Floette early to Hisuian Arcanine’s priority; either preserve it for a safe finishing turn or lead a sturdier combination that pressures Garganacl immediately.
reflections.notebook: Opponent uses Grimmsnarl screens and Prankster disruption, Sableye burn/Taunt support, Garganacl Wide Guard plus Salt Cure/Recover, and Hisuian Arcanine’s Extreme Speed to target Mega Floette. Preserve Mamoswine for Garganacl and use Milotic as a reliable endgame stabilizer. Mega Floette can punish Garganacl but should not be exposed early to Arcanine priority. Rain remains a possible alternate mode through Pelipper and Basculegion.

reflections.summary: Lost because preview brought screens+Arcanine-Hisui+Garganacl into opponent’s Floette-Mega + Dedenne + Mamoswine core; setup was immediately disrupted and the four lacked tools to handle Fairy Aura spread + ground pressure.
reflections.adjustment: Next game preview different four that pressure the Mega or answer Mamoswine directly instead of defaulting to double Prankster + Garganacl wall.
reflections.notebook: Opponent leads Floette-Mega aggressively with Dedenne chip support; Mamoswine threatens walls on switch; Milotic provides safe recovery pivot; preserve Salt Cure value; adjust preview for Fairy/ground cores.
